name: create
description: Create a new automation: Grok runs the prompt on a schedule and/or when an event fires (Gmail/Outlook email, GitHub, Finance, …), and optionally notifies the user. Use this when the user asks to create an automation, reminder, scheduled task, recurring check, or an event-triggered automation — every morning, daily, weekly, at a specific future time, or when an email / GitHub / finance event matches. For event triggers: call `automation_list_trigger_catalog` first (feature flags control which providers appear), then set `trigger` with provider, trigger_type, and dimensions (or email aliases from/to/subject_contains). For GitHub, resolve repos via `automation_list_trigger_resources` and put the returned numeric repository `id` into dimensions.repo (not owner/name). Omit schedule fields for trigger-only. For time-based only, set cadence (or leave empty for run-once). You can combine both.

name.description: Short name for the automation (e.g. 'bitcoin-price-check' or 'emails-from-alice')

prompt.description: The prompt Grok will execute on each run

cadence.description:
RFC 5545 RRULE describing how often the automation runs. Supported forms:
- "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY" (every day)
- "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO" (one weekday) or "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR" (several weekdays), "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR" for every weekday
- "RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=15" (a day of the month)
- "RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY" (once a year)
- "RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY" (every hour). Restrict an hourly cadence to a daily time range via window_start_time / window_end_time and to certain days via BYDAY (e.g. "RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR").
Omit / empty with no trigger → run only once. Omit with a `trigger` → trigger-only (no schedule). Do not include DTSTART/DTEND — use time_of_day + timezone (and window_start_time / window_end_time for hourly) instead.

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 date for one-time automations (e.g. '2026-05-25'). Required when cadence is omitted for a schedule (run-once). Defaults to today if not provided. Omit together with cadence when creating a trigger-only automation.

time_of_day.description: Time in 24h format (e.g. '09:00') for a scheduled run. Defaults to '09:00' when a schedule is created. With a `trigger`, only set this together with cadence/scheduled_date — alone it does not create a schedule. Ignored for hourly cadences (use window_start_time).

window_start_time.description: For hourly (FREQ=HOURLY) automations only: start of the daily run window in 24h 'HH:MM' (e.g. '09:00'). Must be strictly before window_end_time; omit both to run every hour all day.

window_end_time.description: For hourly (FREQ=HOURLY) automations only: inclusive end of the daily run window in 24h 'HH:MM' (e.g. '18:00' still fires at 18:00). Omit both to run every hour all day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Defaults to user's timezone.

trigger.description: Optional event trigger. Call automation_list_trigger_catalog first — only listed providers/types/dimensions are available for this account (some are feature-flagged: GitHub, Finance, …). Prefer `dimensions` map with catalog keys. For email (gmail/outlook) you may use from/to/subject_contains aliases instead; at least one email filter is required. Defaults: trigger_type new_email for gmail/outlook.

provider.description: Event source wire tag from the catalog (e.g. gmail, outlook, github, finance).

trigger_type.description: Event kind from the catalog (e.g. new_email, pr_opened, new_transaction). Required except gmail/outlook (default new_email) and webhook.

dimensions.description: Catalog dimension keys → string or array of strings (e.g. {"from":["@x.ai"], "repo":["314159"], "amount_min":"50"}). Keys must match the catalog entry for this trigger_type. GitHub dimensions.repo MUST be a stringified numeric repository id from automation_list_trigger_resources (resource_type=repository) — never owner/name.

from.description: Email alias for dimensions.from: full email or @domain. String or array.

to.description: Email alias for dimensions.to: full email or @domain. String or array.

subject_contains.description: Email alias for dimensions.subject_contains. String or array.
